## Original text

No original Grouvee text is available in the supplied captures. The HTML and text files are only a Wayback Machine error page stating: “The Wayback Machine has not archived that URL.” They contain no reviews, comments, statistics, or other Grouvee page content. The Wayback Machine navigation, donation prompt, search controls, footer, and terms links have been omitted as site chrome.

### Editorial research notes

The following notes were retained from earlier indexed-text inspection. They are not a transcript of the unavailable Grouvee page and could not be verified against the supplied originals.

Luitenant_Gruber reportedly praises exploratory freedom, character abilities, mouse-drawn attacks, scenery, and music, framing the game as a childhood favorite that remains enjoyable. The review reportedly provides a detailed positive counterpoint to retrospectives frustrated by the same combat controls.

Gunkaloo reportedly records money of 14,840, a score of 100,330, seventy-one percent spared lives, and a displayed game length of 27:09. These are one player's self-reported statistics, not verified score calculations or a representative completion time. The site's separate playtime estimate was reportedly based on only one logged playthrough.

### Access record

The direct request to Grouvee on 2026-09-09 was refused with HTTP 403. The fallback request to the Wayback Machine returned “The Wayback Machine has not archived that URL.” Nothing from the Grouvee page was received, including the two reviews attributed to Luitenant_Gruber (2024-02-20) and Gunkaloo (2025-04-19), the statistics attributed to Gunkaloo (money 14,840; score 100,330; 71 percent spared lives; length 27:09), or the site's playtime estimate. No complete or partial original text can therefore be converted from these files.
